reviews.text: Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

I rescued a four-month-old cat, he is very clean and healthy. We took him and drove all the way down here for vaccination. They refused to take him. The lady said he was an outside cat and needed to be seen by a doctor first. I wouldn't have taken him here if he was already seen by a doctor. The other doctor could have vaccinated him too. This is ridiculous.
The first time to the vet and my pet was okay

Update: Still love coming here! Just had to stop in for a prescription refill. Straightforward, called ahead to have it approved, Dr. Saad came out to discuss my pup, paid up front with Isaac, and on my way. Everyone is friendly and genuinely cares.
__________

We had such an amazing experience with Dr. Saad and Felicia today! Our dog wears a muzzle during vet visits to keep everyone safe, and they were so understanding and had no issue with it. Dr. Saad even encouraged us to take the muzzle off when he saw how calm she was, and she was absolutely perfect. I have to attribute our girls calm demeanor to the two professionals in the room—our dog has never responded to a vet as positively as she did today. They were so kind, helpful, and just genuinely great with her.

I told them about the awful experience we had yesterday with their vaccination clinic, which made me hesitant about today, but wow—what a difference. The hospital staff is a completely different story. If you need a great vet, go to the hospital side—not the clinic—and see Dr. Saad and Felicia. They were so amazing that they’ve officially become our dog’s forever vet and vet tech. Couldn’t recommend them more!

I have been a vital care member of Petco for several years now. I have used both the vetco clinic and the total vetco hospital at petco in Bricktown, Staten Island,  NY.
Recently my dog had a issue that needed surgery. Dr. Saad, was very helpful,  informative and compassionate. He was able to get my Zoey in quickly for surgery and he took care of it completely. He called personally 3x to ask about her after surgery and today he took out her stitches. She has healed very well. I'm very happy with Dr. Saad. He's an excellent veterinarian and surgeon.

Also, I must mention Victoria who answers the phones and checks you in and out - she is wonderful. She's always happy, upbeat, has a smile on her face and helpful.

The technicians that I have interacted with me and my Zoey thru the years are also very thorough and friendly.

I appreciate everyone who works at Vetco Total Care.
The best around. Thank you Fran for always going above & beyond. The staff & doctors are phenomenal.

They have  great  veterinarians here at the Bricktown.Veterinarian hospital they care and have lots of love and tender care for all animals .I and my dog love going there ,He loves people .They aren't strictly just about work they laugh and do there work with live if their jobs and love of the pets.Thank you for all you do ,John Cimino
Staff is so amazing ,professional ,caring . As soon as you walk in you are greeted by Victoria . Dr Saad was great and Fran is amazing . Highly recommend.

I wish I could give zero stars. I took my dog in to have an X-ray, later found out it was medically not necessary, but they still wanted to charge me $700 to have it done. I didn't want my dog to be sedated, and they literally LIED to me and told me it was the law to sedate. (It's not.) Then they claimed the vet left so they couldn't even do the X-ray without sedation, after I asked them to show me the law that says they have to sedate, and they obviously couldn't. Meanwhile, more animals were coming in to be seen. So what vet was seeing them...? Unethical, unprofessional, illegal. And it's sad, I have vital care for YEARS at this point, and this is the first time I've been this upset with a visit. They care about nothing but profits, and could not care less if they kill your dog.
Edit: So I contacted them, after I had already been in contact for months, and no reply. So it looks like they're trying, but they're not. They have done nothing to address this issue.

I’m extremely disappointed in Petco Veterinary Hospital today. I have been a loyal client for years. I have always been on time and I have had a great rapport with all the staff and doctors who have worked with both my dogs. Today I was 10 minutes late and the doctor filling in Dr Savo refused to take me. Especially when the day before I was scheduled for a vaccine but also had to ask questions about her not doing well and they said it was considered a sick visit. Took off work early but unfortunately couldn’t get there in time and called to let them know. I don’t know Dr. Savo but this doctor has no empathy. Very upset.

Excellent staff! Very patient, knowledgeable and explains everything in full detail. Fran at the front desk is the best! Dr Saad and staff is very caring with my dog. They always provide the best treatment for her needs.

I brought my senior dog in for a lump to be checked and I was extremely pleased with the service provided. Fran at reception was so helpful and extremely welcoming. Dana our nurse and Dr. Saad were very kind to not only my baby girl but also made me feel at ease. Now just praying that results come back with good news.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!

The staff at vetco were amazing. From the time me and my pet entered the waiting we were welcomed and taken care of.  Fran was attentive and kind. Dr. Boules is very thorough. I would highly recommend them for your pet.
Sweetest people ever, did an amazing job! felt so comfortable with them
The place was clean and organized and the nurse Natalia was  professional and knowledgeable and as for Dr.Boules thank you.
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
Thank you so much for the great rating! We’re happy to know you had a positive experience. Your support truly means a lot!
They are very understanding accommodating and caring.

I just went in for an appointment with my rescue pitty. He's sometimes fear reactive, but this was the first time I saw him scared at the vet in the few years I've had him. Dr. Boules, Natalia, Danny, and Dana were all so patient and understanding with him so that he could get the care he needed. Because of their patience, eventually Jax was okay being around them and his nerves seemed to calm a bit, which also made me more comfortable as well. Dr. Boules was also very thorough when answering all of my questions and addressing the concerns I had for a separate issue I've been having with Jax.
Thank you guys so much for treating Jax the way you did. Some people automatically respond to him a certain way just because of how he looks, so I really appreciate the chance you all gave him. It means a lot to me. You'll be seeing more of the drama king and I (lol).
